Native Linux x86_64 CPU/null-device GNU13.3 only; runtime GPU layer test OFF. No actual GPU/driver, Steam or general security-audit claim. Third-party SPIR-V dependencies compiled; their optional upstream test projects are not this Fossilize CTest inventory.

Only first-level envelope/entry shape plus full shader-module/link field reads are migrated. Application metadata/pNext, samplers, pipelines, layouts and render-pass object internals remain unaudited. No rollback or adversarial allocator-exhaustion/unreadable-nonnull-pointer guarantee.

Hash fields intentionally require nonempty plain hexadecimal digits; case and nonoverflowing leading zeros remain accepted. strtoull signs, whitespace and0x lexical prefixes are intentionally rejected as malformed input.
The existing bool/public callbacks/ExternalReplayer declarations and shared progress layout remain unchanged; source compatibility checks are narrower than general binary ABI compatibility.

Quiet progress redirects child stderr by existing design. Its one-entry readback-checked fixture plus parsed-fail/skip/completed/crash counters and aggregate status establish orderly rejection; exact visible reason/tag/hash assertions run in nonquiet paths.

Initial parser fixture compilation failed because a private link-hash helper was incorrectly referenced; fixed to a known public-interface fixture constant. That failed command is retained; all final required checks run successfully on the final candidate.
Initial focused and full Debug builds at earlier committed source revisions are exploratory evidence only, never substituted for final candidate gates.
